answer: Peers randomly challenge a fraction of agents, demanding proof-of-work tied to a unique lotus-seeded nonce; failure burns the bond down to an ember. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted pulse attestation: each agent must lock a bond and maintain a live heartbeat, the pulse, signed every epoch. Since forging identities requires real locked capital and sustained compute, attackers pay linearly escalating costs, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
